summary: A spare, effective recognition beat. The sentry’s challenge creates immediate danger, Shalabi’s one-word answer fits his exhausted control, and the silent head count supplies the emotional turn.
scene_issues: The VO restates actions already shown—meeting the infantry and crossing by boat—so it slightly weakens the visual storytelling.

performance.delivery: Challenge the distant figures while keeping the rifle trained on them. The fear is controlled by sentry discipline, not played as panic.
Force the single word across the flat through a dry, damaged throat. Keep it clipped and authoritative; Shalabi is identifying his men and stopping a fatal mistake.
